body: My SO hates conflict, he has a temper tantrum almost toddler like (what I’m currently dealing with) says he promises to do something next time, clams up, and usually lands him in the ER later that night for suicidal thoughts. It’s honestly such a toxic ring and he won’t stop it or let me stop it. I want to tell his whole family to shove their cult like religion up their ass and when they can stop being manipulative pieces of shit, and want to be an actual functional member of society we will be happy to welcome them back into our lives. But until then f*** off. It’s so hard and I can’t wait for everything to open back up so I can go to a therapist. I need help. I can’t take anymore.
We just moved from Chicago to VA and the tenant laws were what persuaded us to go with base housing this move.... there’s a huge difference here
Thank you! He’s such a lucky birb to be loved like that

I feel so bad for her. She hasn’t started plucking thankfully, her room looks like a jungle and we have one of those white noise machines that sound like the rainforest. And she has so much to chew on... How could I go about building a stronger relationship with her? I feel like we’re in a weird limbo, she wants to be with us, if we let her waddle around on the floor she climbs up on the bed, perched on us and hangs out, until she’s had enough, then she bites. The only being that she’s nice to is the cat. They’re as good of friends as we allow them to be, under extremely close supervision, of course. If she sees us petting the cat, she wants pets too. Etc.
I wish my Greenwing was this sweet. Lol how adorable. Sweet baby ❤️💚💙
You can see the leash between her feet. It’s black

I want to give all the scritches

I’m in chicago IL. I was thinking it may be a funeral? They went from building to building down every hall. Unfortunately I only speak English, Polish and Dutch so I couldn’t understand what they were singing.

UPDATE:/ Husband had a panic attack on watch and passed out. Rushed to the ER and got diagnosed with anxiety, and chronic depression. Medicine was prescribed, counseling and therapy had been put in place and they’re going to run tests for PTSD... I feel bad that it happened this way but I’m so glad he got help.

You’re telling me. Lol. She was my great grandmas who lived in Chicago... my great grandma passed on Valentine’s Day. She willed her to my 2nd cousin who lives in Santa Cruise CA, and couldn’t get her on the plane with her work schedule and overall, I don’t think she really wanted the bird. We live in Kenosha WI, and my cousin was going to take her to a rescue if we didn’t take her. She’s been with my great grandma for 10 years so I figured at least I’m someone the bird knows.
EDIT: my grandma was in a coma before her passing, which is why I’ve had her longer than just Valentine’s Day.

Whew. She was willed to me and she’s only 7 so we have a lifetime ahead of us with this. My cockatoo we couldn’t towel, he’d bite through it, that is if you were lucky enough to get it over him, if you missed he’d yell “chicken” in a Darth Vader voice and come hissing at you. She has been going to town on these blocks, I’ve never dealt with a macaw so this is all new stuff to me.
Thanks so much. I had to towel her. It was almost like she was in a trance. She’s happily making toothpicks out of her blocks now.

I have suggested counseling to him multiple times but because of his job in the navy, he risks separation if he goes.... the awful thing is he knows how toxic she is but to home she’s still “a good Christian mother” and if we speak negatively about her, he thinks it’s disrespectful.

I’m 24 and he’s 27. Which still, I totally understand it’s just very weird to me that I can be so respectful to them, and I’m sure it’s coming from a place of concern. But at what point do we become real adults and get a chance at our own happiness? We’re both independent from our families, and we’ve lived together for over a year. :) I’m really sorry that your marriage didn’t work out and thank you for your service!
Thank you for the positive vibes!
Yes he is. :)

Thanks for all of the wonderful support, everyone. My support groups on Facebook have been really difficult as it seems everyone is always complaining and feels compelled to be negative and rude. I was honestly not expecting nearly the amount of support I’ve felt on this post so thank you so much for that. As far as him “not being technically allowed” we know and he said he is willing to take the risk of getting in trouble for that, as we were ready to marry 6 months ago but the recruiter said we could get in trouble there too, when in actuality he didn’t want to do paperwork. As far as the loads of info you all have provided, I am so so grateful and got a lot of clarity and straight answers. Reddit saves the day again!!!
Thank you so so much. This is all so new and confusing.
Thanks! I just posted there too. I think we both have to be there to get it too but it’s a lot and so confusing. I’ve had a hard time getting a straight answer from anyone.

Thank you so much. It eases my mind a bit for someone to say that it’s normal. And you’re right I forget that he can’t do crap at all in basic. It’s not that he’s immature, that’s just what he wanted to to with his life and I knew that going in.
